claims.statement: An advertisement says Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall at 417 Washington Avenue is the best place of amusement in the city, open every evening with the champion presiding.
claims.excerpt: om Allen’s Free Concert Hall, 417 Washington avenue. Best place of amusement in the City. Open every evening. Champion will preside.

notes: Repeat of the advertisement in the 1873-10-07 Globe-Democrat (id 481).
